senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. רגג)to be unsteady, restless; to be agitated.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 10b:7">Taan. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 45:24">Gen. XLV, 24</cite>) <he>שמא תִרְגּוֹז עליכם הדרך</he> lest the road become unsteady for you (you lose your way); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 152:2">Yalk. Gen. 152</cite> <he>תִרְגַּז</he>.

senses.gloss: to stir, excite, incite to anger. Ruth R. end אַרְגֵּיו יצרך (= הַרְגֵּיז), v. כָּעַס; Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 5; Yalk. ib. 627; Pesik. Shub., p. 158ᵃ. Midr. Till. l. c. עד מתי … ומַרְגִּיזִין וכ׳ how long will you sin and create anger by saying &c.?; Yalk. l. c. ומְרַגְּזִים (v. infra).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 5a:2">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>לעולם יַרְגִּיז וכ׳</he> at all times let man stir up his good inclination against his evil inclination.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:6">B. Bath. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>יורד</he> … <he>ומַרְגִּיז וכ׳</he> Satan comes down and leads (men) astray, and goes up and arouses (the Lord’s) anger, takes permission and takes life. Tanḥ. Emor 2 <he>לא היה לך להַרְגִּיז לבוראך וכ׳</he> hadst thou no other means to provoke thy Creator to anger than through me, making me an object of worship?; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 8:7">Esth. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>וידע המרגיז וכ׳</he> and let this provoker (Haman) know that thou hast not forgotten &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be excited, fear. Tanḥ. l. c. הייתי מרגיז שמא וכ׳ I (Samuel) was frightened, lest it be the judgment day, and I feared myself.

units: <cite ref="Niddah 16b:55">Nidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שר הנִרְגָּז</he> (<he>בבית המשתאות</he>) a chief officer (or scholar) that gets excited in the drinking house (a variant to <he>הנרגן</he>), v. <cite ref="T00202"><he>רָגַל</he></cite> a. <cite ref="T00215"><he>רָגַן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to rage. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 9 התחילו מְרַגְּזִין they began to rage. Yalk. Ps. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="T00172">same</cite>. Mekh. l. c. <he>מִתְרַגְּזִין</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 251:7">Yalk. Ex. 251</cite>.
